# Code of conduct

Stage Manager is a small project, and everyone who takes part (in issues, discussions and
pull requests) is expected to be kind and constructive.

- Be respectful, whatever someone's experience, background or opinion.
- Talk about the work, not the person. Disagree with ideas, not with people.
- No harassment, insults, personal attacks, or sexual or discriminatory language or images.
- Don't share anyone's private information without their permission.

## Reporting

If someone's behaviour bothers you, report it privately with
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/eugene-tea/stage-manager/security/advisories/new)
on the Security tab (it is the repository's private channel; say it is about conduct).
Reports are read only by the maintainer and kept confidential.

## What happens

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close threads, or block someone from the
project, depending on what happened. A first small slip usually gets a friendly word.

Based on the ideas of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org).
